## Checker warnings

- LED_BUILTIN: GPIO2 is a strapping pin (must be LOW/floating at boot for serial flashing)
- BTN2: GPIO0 is a strapping pin (must be HIGH at boot (BOOT button))
- SD_CS: GPIO5 is a strapping pin (controls SDIO timing at boot)
- MAX7219_CS: GPIO15 is a strapping pin (MTDO - LOW at boot silences the boot log)  [with Keypad=none, LedMatrix=max7219_4in1; Keypad=none, LedMatrix=max7219_8x8; Keypad=pcf8574_4x4, LedMatrix=max7219_4in1; Keypad=pcf8574_4x4, LedMatrix=max7219_8x8]
- 15 pin(s) not yet verified on hardware: LED_BUILTIN, LED_RED, LED_GREEN, LED_YELLOW, BUZZER, RELAY, BTN1, BTN2, SWITCH, POT, LDR, DHT, PIR, SD_CS, RS485_DE
